adultGuidance: Read each story together first, then let your child read it, then read it again. Listen for smooth, expressive reading rather than speed, and let your child fix small slips on their own. Try the page activity together, then ask the one question. If a story feels hard, read the tricky line together and stop while it is still fun.
description: Read and reread five short decodable stories to build accuracy, smoothness, and expression, with one quick understanding check on each page.
learningFocus: Read every word in a short story, then read it again, smoothly.
Read in groups of words that go together, pausing at each scoop.
Use ! and ? to read with an excited voice and a wondering voice.
Read the same story three times and notice what gets better.
Read a story on your own, then read it again and tell what happened.
